description: Poll the lightweight review status of a submitted software (progress, sub-step, rate-limit budget). Returns { tool_id, tool_status, version, review_job_status, review_sub_step, review_passed, rejection_reason, review_started_at, review_completed_at, rate_limit }. Polling: poll every 30 s until review_job_status is neither "queued" nor "running"; a full review takes 5-15 minutes. If review_passed is true: the tool is approved and live. If review_passed is false after completion: call get_review_report for structured findings, fix the reported issues, then call update_software with the fixed build and poll again. Use get_review_report only after polling is done, not for live progress. Also shows rate_limit.updates_remaining_today so you know your budget before calling update_software, and rate_limit.window_resets_at shows when the update budget resets. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.
name: check_review_status
title: Check Crela review status
